rewrites.comment: The API is proxied through this origin rather than called cross-site. Sessions are HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookies, which a browser will not attach to a cross-origin fetch — proxying keeps them same-origin, exactly as the Vite dev proxy does locally. Change the destination to the real Render URL.
Google redirects the browser here after consent. It must reach the API, not the SPA — the handler exchanges the code and then redirects back into the app.
Everything else is client-routed: /privacy, /terms and the app itself. Without this a refresh on any path but / returns a 404 from the CDN.

headers.comment: Vite fingerprints these filenames, so the content at a given URL never changes and can be cached indefinitely.
The worker must never be cached, or a deploy cannot replace it and users are stuck on an old shell.
